crossRefs.note: Of Simeon: Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
On the fifth day Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai, prince of the children of Simeon,

people.name: Shelumiel
people.line: Leader of the tribe of Simeon

people.name: Simeon
people.line: Son of Jacob and Leah, one of the twelve tribes.

people.name: Zurishaddai
people.line: Father of Shelumiel, leader of Simeon

translations.web: Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai was over the army of the tribe of the children of Simeon.
translations.bsb: Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai was over the division of the tribe of Simeon,
translations.kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Simeon was Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
translations.asv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Simeon was Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
